title: Agreement of normalized common-stage Frobenius squares
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, a prime l distinct from D.p, an algebraic closure \Omega of Q_l, finite-type arithmetic models X_0,Y_0, a morphism f_0:X_0\to Y_0 and an arbitrary object K in the common-stage constructible coefficient category of its geometric target. The component (zlFrobeniusSquare D l hl \Omega f_0).app K equals podCommonSquarePullbackComponent l \Omega (zlFiberMap D f_0) g_X g_Y (zlFrobenius_naturality D f_0) K. Both comparisons retain the actual normalized composition maps; this assertion involves no constant objects, Tate line, smoothness or purity. The first square is defined in [def-zl-weil-ind-sheaf-category]; the second is defined in [lem-pod-semilinear-field-operation-lifts] using the composition comparison of [lem-pur-derived-pullback-tensor-iso]. The prime-invertibility instances are those of [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], and K ranges over the common-stage category of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients].

proof.text: Extract the integral component formula for zlPullComp from zlPullComp_existsUnique and cancel its equality-only object transports. This gives zl_composition_integral: the component is heterogeneously equal to the stage inclusion of the localized integral compositor, without altering the chosen compositor.

Specialize rationalPullbackScalarComparison_tower to three identical coefficient fields and identity embeddings. The source-unit clauses of sfRationalScalar_coherence rewrite the scalar associators. Naturality of the pullback/scalar comparison moves the source unitor through that comparison. Cancel the invertible comparison, then reflect equality through identity scalar extension, which is faithful because sfRationalScalarUnit identifies it with the identity functor. This gives rational_scalar_unit. Transport along the actual coefficient-inclusion identity law and the recorded operationStageTransitionIso to obtain comparison_self, including both stage-system and scalar unit comparisons.

Prove naturality of the rational compositor by tensor induction on rational morphisms. The zero and sum cases use additivity. On a pure tensor, use the prescribed rational pullback formula and the rational compositor normalization to reduce the equation to integralPullbackComposition naturality multiplied by the same scalar. Package these components with NatIso.ofComponents.

Evaluate pullbackTensorCommonComposition_existsUnique at the original coefficient stage of the arbitrary pair P. Apply comparison_self to its three boundary comparisons. Naturality of the rational compositor with respect to the coefficient unitor cancels these boundary factors: the representative is the stage transition applied to the original rational compositor. By the definition of the stage inclusion, its class is inclusion.map of that rational compositor. Its rational normalization identifies this with inclusion.map of the localized integral compositor. The first step therefore identifies (zlPullComp f g).app P with pullbackTensorCommonComposition g f P for every f,g,P.

Expand zlFrobeniusSquare at K into its inverse first compositor, equality transport and second compositor. Rewrite both compositor components by the preceding equality. The middle equality transports agree by eqToHom_app and proof irrelevance, giving exactly podCommonSquarePullbackComponent.

lean.statement:
theorem commonFrobeniusSquare_eq
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω] [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω]
    {X₀ Y₀ : Over (Spec (.of D.k₀))}
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X₀.hom] [QuasiCompact X₀.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Y₀.hom] [QuasiCompact Y₀.hom]
    (f₀ : X₀ ⟶ Y₀)
    (K : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω (D.geometricFiber Y₀).left) :
    letI := fun x ↦ sfWeilPrimeInvertible D l hl X₀ x
    letI := fun y ↦ sfWeilPrimeInvertible D l hl Y₀ y
    (zlFrobeniusSquare D l hl Ω f₀).app K =
      podCommonSquarePullbackComponent l Ω (zlFiberMap D f₀)
        (D.geometricFrobenius X₀).hom (D.geometricFrobenius Y₀).hom
        (zlFrobenius_naturality D f₀) K
